description: A warm, wood-paneled study filled with ancient puzzle books, carved wooden boxes, and curious mechanical contraptions. The Puzzle Master left their greatest brain-teasers here — solve them to prove your worth.

levels.title: Book Shuffle
hints: 📚 Slide tiles into the blank space to order them 1..N.
📚 A 3×3 board — the empty square is your mover.
📚 The solved board reads 1 2 3 … left-to-right, top-to-bottom.
